title: CompileProgress
description:
One progress report, for every stage alike. Reports arrive in stage order;
within a stage `stage_fraction` never decreases, and `overall` never
decreases over a compile. The last report of a successful compile is
[`CompileStage::WritePackage`] at fraction 1 (`overall` 1).

message.description:
Diagnostic text in English, such as the objects read so far in the
ingest ("Indexed 1200 node locations and 3 relations"). An app shows its
own text per stage.

overall.description:
The share of the whole compile done, 0 to 1 (stages weighted by their
usual share of the time).

stageFraction.description:
The share of this stage done, 0 to 1, when the stage's size is known:
blobs read in the ingest, steps of the graph and package builds,
Dijkstras for landmarks, bytes written.

CompileStage.description:
The stages of a compile, in the order they run. The serialized names
(`as_str`) are stable ids an app can key its own text on.

oneOf.description: Ingest pass 1: node locations, relations and tagged nodes.
Ingest pass 2: road ways and turn-restriction relations.
The road graph: topology, restrictions, enrichment and repair.
Edge costs and the package's sections other than landmarks.

ALT landmarks for each profile column (none by default), then the
node order of CCH potentials.
Checksums, the file written and synced, then reopened.
